rca of the issue: Root cause: the code change described in the review_request was not saved. `grep -n 'require_user' /app/backend/annotation_routes.py` shows require_user only on /admin/* endpoints and /cognitive-profile — the three public GET routes are unchanged. Reproduction: `curl -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://cognitive-hierarchy.preview.emergentagent.com/api/annotations/by-question/ENEM/2022/Azul/137` → 200 with gabarito='C' in body. Mitigation: add `user: User = Depends(require_user)` parameter to the three route signatures at lines 97, 115, 123.
